title: Native mobile client (iOS/Android)
description: Placeholder epic (Mark 2026-10-18): a native mobile MIMI client built on mimid-agent-core (decision mimid-1wgh.39) via a mobile binding. Not decomposed yet (decompose just in time). Open questions: UI technology (native SwiftUI/Compose over a UniFFI core vs a shared toolkit such as Flutter via flutter_rust_bridge, as the Aura spec planned); provider push (wake-only APNs/FCM: provider-side bead needed); keys at rest in Keychain/Keystore (mimi-mls Store is unencrypted today); background limits and catch-up; mobile TLS provider; distribution and signing. Depends on .13.
